note: The figure gym's scripted hand: what the human's keys and stick do, frame by frame, for the real rink core (RinkCore, FJamInput by thirdjam's names). Segments in order; n = frames. move = FJamInput.Move in rink coordinates (x along the rink, y across). stick_rel_deg = where the stick points against the skater's facing of the frame before, degrees, positive = to his left ([a] or [from, to] across the segment); stick_len = |Stick| (the fraction of game.stick.reach_m), a number or [from, to]. sprint, brake = the held buttons.
